To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the proposed gCAR measure is a good predictor of future usage of a candidate API, and 2) MashupRECO is a good API recommender tool, that reduces significantly the search time for a given degree of completeness, and is particularly effective in the cold-start case.

the global Co utilization API Ranking (gCAR) is calculated using Association Rules inferred from historical API data, and that MashupRECO combines gCAR with a keyword-based measure to avoid the cold start problem for new or untested APIs.
the proposed global co utilization API ranking measure (gCAR) improves the quality of the API recommendations for Mashup completion.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of helping developers to find relevant APIs to use in their mashups by recommending APIs based on their co-usage in previous mashups.
the problem of recommending APIs for mashup completion, using association rules mined from real usage data.
the following question: How to recommend APIs to a user building a mashup?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method is a significant step forward in the direction of improving the API recommendation process.
MashupRECO is an effective and useful tool to help the mashup builder to choose the best set of APIs to assemble in his mashups.

the proposed method can be used as a complementary approach to existing keyword-based search engines, in order to provide better results in terms of completeness and relevance, especially in cases where there is not enough information available to perform a proper search.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the gCAR ranking measure, and the MashupRECO system are useful for mashup builders who need to choose APIs for their mashups.
MashupRECO is a tool that can be used by a mashup builder to quickly find a good set of candidate APIs to use in his/her mashup, based on the APIs already selected.

the gCAR ranking measure, based on association rule mining of API usage data, can help mashup builders choose among the available APIs, and that the MashupRECO system, which combines gCAR and the keywordbased search, is an effective tool to recommend API candidates to a mashup developer.
The main takeaway from our work is that
API recommendation based on API co utilization is a promising approach, which can be further refined and improved.
the gCAR measure, based on real usage data, is more effective than the keyword based ranking of ProgrammableWeb, and can be used to recommend APIs for mashup completion.
the co utilization information of APIs in real mashups can be used to improve the recommendation of APIs to mashup builders.
